correctness.rationale: The universal proof enumerates each smaller candidate residue by the parity-of-coin-count and index-sum identity, supplies two explicit distinct factorizations at every proposed Apéry threshold, and uses injection under addition of the least generator for all larger elements. The genus formula counts all residue representatives below those thresholds; the finite singleton lists follow from the same low-candidate census. The executable program independently validates 299 families and 45,597 residue thresholds, including 19 differently implemented exact counts. No finite experiment is used to prove an infinite quantifier.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The new minima are not a corollary of upper witnesses: each upper witness might have an earlier double-representable predecessor. Proving no such predecessors exist for every residue is the additional structural statement. The previously known F_1 maxima match consequences of the evaluated formulas and are not claimed as new.

originality.rationale: The 2026 same-object source obtains p-Frobenius numbers and bounded witness sets, not evaluated all-residue first-double minima, singleton loci, or 1-genus. The 2021 general Apéry formula provides the subsequent summation but does not imply the evaluated minima. The present mathematical implication comparison isolates the all-residue minimality as the new work. Actual targeted searches and currently accessible deduplication did not yield covering claims; independent historical priority is unresolved.

An earlier equivalent all-residue evaluation under unrelated terminology or an unpublished table could escape finite searches.
Independent expert historical-priority and proof review remain outstanding.

value.rationale: The same-object 2026 paper focuses on the largest p-Frobenius gap. A complete all-residue first-double threshold classification is a natural independently meaningful object: it determines the entire two-representation generating series, exact p=1 genus, and every integer with exactly one factorization for two unbounded-embedding-dimension families. The values are not arbitrary slices of a table, and they require actual all-residue minimality beyond the known upper witnesses and maximum. This is a complete small-p structural classification, not a claim about higher p.
